auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Picky Assist V4 project API token. Create a token under Settings > Developers > API: https://app.pickyassist.com/settings/developers/api. Your plan must include API access.

actions.name: get_balance
actions.description: Get the Picky Assist account balance using the connected project API token.

balance.description: Available account balance reported by Picky Assist.

actions.name: send_messages
actions.description: Submit text or public-URL media messages to one or more Picky Assist recipients. Success means accepted for processing, not delivered. WhatsApp session and channel restrictions still apply.

application.description: Channel ID from https://app.pickyassist.com/settings/channels; use 5 for Facebook Messenger.

globalmessage.description: Shared text or image/video caption, used when a recipient message is empty.

globalmedia.description: Public media URL fetched by Picky Assist, not by Connector. Media limits depend on the channel and file type.

media_name.description: Display filename for PDFs and documents; unsupported by Phone Automation.

priority.description: Queue priority: 0 for low (default), 1 for high.

createcontact.description: Set to 1 to create contacts against the channel.

voice.description: Set to 1 to send audio as a voice note on WhatsApp Web Automation.

number.description: Phone number with country code, without a leading zero, plus sign, or spaces.

messenger_id.description: Facebook Messenger recipient ID; use with application 5 instead of number.

message.description: Personalized text or image/video caption; falls back to globalmessage when empty.

media.description: Public media URL for this recipient; supported by WhatsApp Official and Shared Numbers.

reference_number.description: Your reference returned in delivery webhooks; not an idempotency key.

quoted.description: Message ID to quote in a reply on WhatsApp Web Automation.

items.description: One recipient and optional personalized message or media.

data.description: Recipients with optional personalized content. Each needs text or media, either shared or individual.

inputSchema.description: Text or media messages for a connected channel.

msg_id.description: Message ID allocated by Picky Assist.

credit.description: Credit charged as reported by the provider.

items.description: One recipient result, including any additional provider fields.

outputSchema.description: Submission response; use delivery webhooks to determine final delivery.
